title: FindingsDocument
description: What a critic check prints on stdout: an independent reviewer's findings about one candidate. Identity sdk.syberlabs.space/critic/1, separate from the frozen v0alpha1 event vocabulary. The host (syberlabs.critic.parse) refuses a document that does not conform, with findings_invalid:<path>, and refuses a reviewer equal to the candidate's provider name@revision with reviewer_not_independent. The host stores the parsed document as an observed event (key critic, source check:<name>, verified true) whose value is bounded to 65536 bytes; findings_digest in that value is the SHA-256 of the full stdout bytes.

usage.description: Optional: the model usage of the critic's own call, in the adapter protocol's shape. The host keeps the known fields and records them as an observed event (key critic_usage, source check:<name>) beside the critic observation; a declaration, not a host measurement.
